records.source: Yaguang Yang, Spacecraft Modeling, Attitude Determination, and Control, equation 5.5; author manuscript hosted by NASA NTRS https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20240009554/downloads/Space%20Attitude%20Development%20Control.pdf
records.conditions: Torque 3*mu/r^3*n cross (I*n); n and the central inertia tensor use the same body frame. The expansion requires spacecraft size much smaller than attractor distance.
records.uncertainty: Exact first-order coefficient; higher gravitational multipoles and higher spacecraft-size terms are omitted.

records.source: Uniform circular-area integration, mean(x^2)=mean(y^2)=a^2/4; NASA/CR-1998-208246, Dynamics of Variable Mass Systems, section 4.3.1 and equations 4.26-4.31, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19980210404/downloads/19980210404.pdf
records.variant: Uniform outward mass flux over a circular exit plane
records.conditions: The exit covariance contributes mdot*a^2/4*(Identity+n*n^T) to angular-momentum transport, in addition to the exit-centroid parallel-axis tensor. Axial spin transport is mdot*a^2/2.
records.uncertainty: Exact for the stated uniform disk. Nonuniform exit flow and swirl require a different exit model; this coefficient is not an empirical vehicle damping gain.

records.source: Fidelis O. Eke, Dynamics of Variable Mass Systems, NASA/CR-1998-208246, section 3.2, equations 3.12-3.18, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19980210404/downloads/19980210404.pdf
records.variant: Open-system angular-momentum balance about instantaneous centre of mass
records.conditions: Transport torque -I_dot*omega - J_out*omega - omega cross h_relative - d(h_relative)/dt_body - c_dot cross p_relative; positive mdot denotes outward flow. The last term is the moving-CoM-origin correction when relative flow velocities are defined in the material body frame. Ordinary thrust moments and Euler gyroscopic torque are supplied separately. All derivatives and vectors must refer to the same body frame and centre.
records.uncertainty: The supported coupled production path evaluates relative-flow momentum from the declared store-to-outlet route (rigid_body_f4_outlets_2026.json); zero relative-flow momentum still requires an explicit symmetry or negligible-flow assumption. Actual feed-line bends and swirl are not resolved. Legacy/water and unsupported funding/outlet cases retain the documented frozen-mass fallback.

records.source: Numerical accuracy policy of CoastingAttitudeIntegrator; validation in CoastingAttitudeIntegratorTests (analytic rotation, tidal libration, free-body momentum/energy and warp partition convergence).
records.variant: Adaptive attitude-only RK4 on a prescribed Kepler centre-of-mass conic
records.conditions: Step-doubling local orientation error budget per simulated second (rad/s), scaled by max(1 rad/s, maximum trial angular rate) to bound error per swept radian for rapid spin and avoid demanding sub-roundoff errors.
records.uncertainty: Numerical integration control, not a measured physical parameter or damping coefficient. Step doubling estimates truncation error; global accuracy is independently checked against analytic solutions and conserved quantities. No historical gate tolerance is changed.
